records.title: Natural Earth 1:110m land outlines
assumptions: Natural Earth low-LOD land outlines displayed as coastline context.
Snapshot timestamp is upstream commit date, not observation date.
records.uncertainty: Cartographic generalization at 1:110 million; not survey-grade coastline.
limitations: Small islands and local detail are omitted.
Not terrain, buildings, administrative borders, or a hazard model.
Hidden below 200 km camera altitude rather than implying local accuracy.
records.attribution: Made with Natural Earth. Tom Patterson, Nathaniel Vaughn Kelso and contributors.
records.license: Public domain; upstream license bundled with snapshot.

records.title: Local Building Footprints and Extrusions
assumptions: Footprints represent 2D building perimeters with extruded vertical heights.
Heights without explicit survey tags are inferred from storey count or regional median assumption (3.0 m/storey).
records.uncertainty: Building heights without explicit roof tags are estimated; internal occupancy, material structural resistance and subterranean floors are unobserved.
limitations: Coverage is bounded to indexed regional cells and sampled metro/local focus areas.
Rendered extrusions are simplified 3D LOD1 geometries, not engineering structural BIM models.
Active only at local camera altitudes below 15,000 m.
records.attribution: Building footprint data © OpenStreetMap contributors / Overture Maps Foundation. ODbL / CDLA-Permissive-2.0.
records.license: ODbL 1.0 and CDLA-Permissive-2.0 compatible open data terms.
records.coverage: Sampled regional and urban focus tiles at 0.05-degree grid resolution.
